name: deckard
description: Token-streamed live-coding DAW in Tish — LLM + human co-DJ over deck

scripts.dev: npm run build:og && npm run build:docs && vite
scripts.build: tish build --target js src/main.tish -o dist/bundle.js && tish build --target js src/ScopeWorker.tish -o scope-worker.js && npm run build:codj-worker
scripts.build:codj-cli: tish build --target js services/codj-runner/main.tish -o services/codj-runner/codj.mjs && tish build --target js services/mcp/main.tish -o services/mcp/mcp.mjs
scripts.codj:login: npm run -s build:codj-cli && node services/codj-runner/codj.mjs login
scripts.build:static: npm run build:og && npm run build:docs && npm run build && node scripts/build-static.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:tish && npm run test:ratchet
scripts.agent:host: npm run -s build:codj-cli && node services/codj-runner/codj.mjs run --agent --role host
scripts.agent:client: npm run -s build:codj-cli && node services/codj-runner/codj.mjs run --agent --role client
scripts.test:js: npm run test:smoke && npm run test:mp && npm run test:levels && npm run test:multiword && npm run test:voicereset && npm run test:deckjoin && npm run test:transport && npm run test:deckmix && npm run test:wavetables && npm run test:agentkit && npm run test:codj-docs
